experience.title: Full-stack / Product Owner
experience.body:
I successfully integrated a well-established platform into WordPress, overseeing the seamless migration of content, user data, and media. I crafted custom templates and plugins to deliver a distinctive user experience, complemented by refined Locomotive and GSAP animations. Additionally, I implemented robust user management, authentication, and content moderation for a secure and professional WordPress environment.

▪ Migration to a new CMS, which hosts over 9000 teachers and 180+ school profiles;
▪ Led the complete end-to-end rework of the movie association's platform, transitioning it to a new
environment, using WordPress, and bringing it up to 2022 standards. Implemented a custom-built
Theme from scratch as well as Custom Post Types utilising ACF;
▪ Applied several custom modifications to the WPAdmin as well as migrated all content from 2009
up to 2022.
experience.editorialStatus: Owner-published claims; confirm dates and numerical claims before republishing

experience.title: Front-end Developer & Project Owner
experience.body:
Led diverse web development projects by implementing best practices and standards, collaborating with clients and teams as a "Project Owner" of several projects, designing interfaces, themes, and plugins, mentoring front-end team-members, and coordinating with Project Managers to drive successful sprints and launches.

▪ Project Owner of several high-end large products and startups. Designed and developed
interfaces, themes, and plugins;
▪ Created and maintained the marketing website of a workplace analytics startup managed to set up
a successful campaign which raised $51 Million, with over 15,000 concurrent daily users;
▪ Mentored a handful of Jr. Developers within the front-end team, creating challenges and setting up
coding standards, peer programming, code reviews, and more
